rows.finding: Phase 1 is not hermetic. validate_grade opens the configured database (SessionLocal), so §10's verdict depends on an external host resolving.
rows.baseline_evidence: 2026-09-12: the SAME tree crashed on Neon DNS earlier in the day and passed §10 hours later on identical code, because the network came back. This is non-determinism in a gate (Protocol 6), not merely a crash — a stronger finding than 'aborts on DNS'.
